frozen_belief: 北大荒的主要股东经济是以国有耕地发包、统一管理与服务为核心的准租赁/管理现金流。2026年14.10亿元历史补税及滞纳金为一次性结算并已支付，不应年化；但非职工家庭农场对应土地承包收入不享受原优惠，使长期税后盈利和现金创造能力较旧口径永久下调。新增经常性所得税约2亿元量级仅为工作假设，精确税基仍UNKNOWN。

valuation_context.interpretation: 18-24x spans a de-rated-to-upper-normal same-company context; 15x is explicit deep-stress. No multiple is asserted as a unique fair value.

reverse_underwriting.interpretation: At the current price, a 10% three-year gross return requires roughly CNY1.50bn/1.29bn/1.13bn terminal net income at 18x/21x/24x respectively, before personal tax and costs. The upper-multiple case needs only modest earnings growth but also requires the tax/dividend/governance reset not to de-rate the company.

price_cards.label: CURRENT_WAIT_UNDER_10PCT_WORKING_REQUIREMENT
price_cards.reason: At 12.33, 10% three-year gross CAGR generally requires a favorable combination of higher terminal earnings and/or an upper-end terminal multiple; ordinary normalized earnings around CNY1.0-1.05bn do not robustly clear the working hurdle.

price_cards.label: RE_UNDERWRITE_8PCT_ZONE
price_cards.reason: Around CNY11.27, the CNY1.05bn / 22x / CNY1.20 cumulative-dividend sensitivity reaches about 8% gross three-year CAGR. This is not a Human-accepted hurdle or buy trigger.

price_cards.label: CONDITIONAL_FIRST_ENTRY_REVIEW
price_cards.reason: Around CNY10.66, the CNY1.05bn / 22x / CNY1.20 cumulative-dividend sensitivity reaches about 10% gross three-year CAGR. This is a review region only and depends on frozen Belief remaining intact.

price_cards.label: MATERIALLY_BETTER_ODDS_REVIEW
price_cards.reason: Around CNY8.82, a lower-core CNY0.95bn / 20x / CNY1.05 cumulative-dividend sensitivity reaches about 10% gross three-year CAGR. A price fall here may itself signal new Evidence and must be re-underwritten.

price_cards.label: DEEP_REUNDERWRITE
price_cards.reason: This begins to approach deep-stress arithmetic rather than a standing averaging rule. A move here should be treated as possible new information, not automatically better Odds.
